description: Buying-intent category queries for financial technology for businesses: accounting, payments, cards, billing and spend tools. No brand names: the brand under test either appears in the answer or it does not.

prompts.text: What's the best accounting software for a small business with five employees?
Which invoicing tools work best for freelancers who bill clients in several currencies?
How do I choose a payment processor for an online store with low margins?
What are the best expense management tools for a 30-person company?
Which business bank accounts have the lowest fees for a new startup?
What's the best corporate card for a company that spends mostly on software and ads?
Which bookkeeping services work well for e-commerce sellers with high transaction volume?
What are the best tools for managing accounts payable that connect to our accounting software?
How do I pick a billing platform for a subscription software company?
Which payroll and tax filing tools are best for a small business in a single state?
What's the best way to accept international payments without high currency fees?
Which budgeting and forecasting tools suit a startup preparing for a funding round?
What are good alternatives to traditional banks for a small business that needs a line of credit?
Which fraud-prevention tools work best for an online business with a small team?
Which tools make it easiest to collect late payments from business customers?
What should I look for in a financial planning tool for a company with a few investors?
Which cap table and equity management tools are best for an early-stage startup?
What's the best way to choose accounting software for a nonprofit?

brandsNote: Lexicon for competitor extraction. Empty: no lexicon has been built for this vertical yet, and no brand names are invented here. A name matches case-insensitively at word boundaries, using the name plus any aliases. Entries marked ambiguous are common English words and only count in a name-like position (bold, a heading or a list-item label).
